def process(topTenCategories):
    import pandas as pd

    df = topTenCategories.copy()
    # Fix header that appears as first data row due to file structure
    header_row = df.iloc[0].tolist()
    df = df.iloc[1:].copy()
    df.columns = header_row

    # Drop trailing footnote / blank rows
    df = df.dropna(subset=['State', 'Category'])

    # The first category listed per state is the "top" category
    df['_rowWithinState'] = df.groupby('State').cumcount()
    top_per_state = df[df['_rowWithinState'] == 0]

    out = (
        top_per_state[top_per_state['Category'] == 'Identity Theft'][['State']]
        .drop_duplicates()
        .sort_values('State')
        .reset_index(drop=True)
    )
    return out

operators.customDisplayName: Determine states whose top (rank-1) report category is 'Identity Theft': treat first data row as header (set columns to [State, Category, # of Reports, Percentage]); drop rows with null State/Category (footnotes/blanks); within each State, take the first listed category (groupby State cumcount==0) as top; filter top rows where Category=='Identity Theft'; return sorted unique State names.
